test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and fourth term related to the third term.

SUGAR : 11 :: PILOT : 12 :: HOTEL : ?
solution:
According to the alphabetical positions of the letters,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9cb5594c782ab3e95c5cc3e8f71d9efa85b5afd0e3cda082b6f43da2e8b02868.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**(Sum of position value of consonant - sum of position value of vowel) ÷ 2 = code**

SUGAR : 11

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/595b994e3dbb22dd449deacdd9b9628934ee94167c8bd88f833d3b777e47546c.png] 

And,

PILOT : 12

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e91a564d65fdb6614efe06b17378472e6641cc1eaaf4ffee3577a8f4c11ba64.png] 

Similarly,

HOTEL : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecb11c580319cc3030361e5e56562361b6e9534025811a49f4f6f37e128e0503.png] 

Hence, ‘10’ is the correct answer.
